descriptions.w3d_d28e_register_item_801a2754: Register an item in two parallel pointer vectors at +36 and +60. When the object's kind field is 3 both vectors are resized to the global table size at 0x804b18d8, the item is stored at its index in the first and zero in the second; the special object at 0x80365094 instead calls 0x801a2d68 with one entry.
